create_zero_shot_object_detection_pipeli: create a zero-shot object detection pipeline using OwlViT to predict bounding boxes from candidate labels
run_detect_objects_in_image: run object detection on a single image with candidate labels and return bounding boxes with scores
test_batch_object_detection: test batch object detection on a list of images with corresponding candidate labels per image
run_sanitize_postprocess_params: run postprocessing with configurable threshold and top_k to filter and rank detection results
review_get_bounding_box_method: review the bounding box conversion method that transforms torch tensor coordinates into a dictionary
